aramco_iss_cycle_time.user_query: Where is my issue-to-verify time going?
aramco_iss_cycle_time.ai_message: Twenty-four permits are queued waiting on verification, and the queue is not sorted by risk — it is sorted by arrival. A routine low-risk permit can sit most of a morning behind a hot-work check that needs a physical inspection, which is where the crews' idle time comes from. Roughly 70% of verifier time goes to high-risk work that is about 13% of the permit volume, which is correct; the waste is the other 87% waiting in the same line. Clearing low-risk permits on location evidence instead of a walk-out would take the queue down without moving a single verifier off the jobs that matter.
